name: Nimbus Fabrication Pulse Bracelet
description:
A slim wrist-worn band that monitors pulse, blood oxygen, stress hormones, and neural activity baseline in real time. The band's exterior is featureless matte black; all data is transmitted to a paired device or AR display. A panic-button feature sends the wearer's location and vitals to pre-designated contacts when double-tapped.

Used by corponation employees whose employers monitor their biometrics as a condition of employment, and independently by individuals who want a dead-man's switch — if the heart stops, the bracelet talks.
functionality: Real-time biometric monitoring, panic alert, dead-man's switch capability
what_it_says: Your body's vital signs are being watched, either by your employer or by someone who cares whether you're still alive.
story_hooks: A Pulse Bracelet's dead-man's switch activates, transmitting a final location — but the wearer is found alive and well at that location, with no memory of the last four hours and vitals that show they technically died and restarted.

physical_description.visual_profile: A minimalist smart bracelet that sits flush against the wrist like a second skin. Its featureless matte black surface catches no light, creating a visual void. The band appears almost invisible until movement reveals its subtle contours. Worn by both corporate drones under mandatory monitoring and paranoid survivalists who view it as insurance.
physical_description.fit: Snug compression fit, contoured to wrist geometry. Barely perceptible weight distribution. Sits just tight enough to maintain constant biometric contact without cutting circulation.
physical_description.primary_material: Synthetic elastomer composite with embedded bio-responsive polymers. Matte black exterior coating with subdermal sensor arrays.
physical_description.texture: Smooth and featureless to the touch, almost creepy in its uniformity. Slightly tacky against skin for sensor stability. No seams or visible mechanical components—seamless construction.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte black throughout. Zero accent colors. The absence of design *is* the design.
physical_description.closures: Friction-fit, no visible fasteners. The wearer slides it on and its elastomer memory conforms to wrist diameter. Double-tap pressure-sensitive surface activates panic protocol.
distinctive_features: Completely featureless exterior—no logos, displays, or indicator lights
Embedded dual-tap pressure zone (usually at the 12 o'clock position on wrist)
Imperceptible thickness (~3mm) makes it nearly translucent in profile
Bio-responsive polymer adjusts tension based on wearer's stress hormones
Wireless transmission to paired neural interface or AR display
Dead-man's switch: cardiac arrest triggers automatic SOS broadcast
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 corporate (mandatory), Tier 3 independent users (optional safety). The uniformity signals either corporate surveillance or paranoid wealth.
physical_description.cultural_context: Wearing one marks you as either a corpo asset under biometric lease or someone wealthy enough to afford redundant life insurance. Sub-grade populations cannot afford the Φ1,200+ initial cost. Street gangs ironically wear counterfeit versions as status symbols.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine—the matte coating resists fingerprints and wear patterns. Even after months of use, it looks factory-fresh. This perfection is part of its unsettling aesthetic.

image_prompt: Close-up fashion photography of a matte black Nimbus Pulse Bracelet on a pale wrist against dark urban concrete backdrop. Moody blue-green neon underglow illuminates the bracelet's featureless surface from below, revealing only its subtle contours and pressure-sensitive tap zone. Shallow depth of field. Blurred skyline of the Great Lakes Metropolitan Zone in the background—rain-slicked, neon-reflected. The bracelet's seamless form creates an almost uncanny perfection. Shot at 45-degree angle to emphasize the band's invisible quality. Neo-noir corporate surveillance aesthetic. --ar 2:3 --v 6
